title: I Took the Planetarium Laser-Show Seating to the Intern Who Saved a Row

parts.text: I scanned general seating at 8:03 p.m. and intern Theo had backpacks across row C with a sticky: STAFF HOLD. The ticket said: OPEN SEATING. NO HOLDS. STAFF SITS LAST. I was thirty-two, night show, holding a stub. Theo did not move the packs. "Interns are the sky." I photographed the sticky, the stub, and the empty row. Then I logged a hold. At 8:11 the show lead asked why Theo's sticky was on general row C. I waited where the camera already was. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The show lead can see backpacks across row C under a staff-hold sticky.

social.video_title: The intern saved a whole row with backpacks — Part 1/2
social.description: Planetarium, open seating, and a staff sticky. I logged the hold. Would you have photographed the packs?

parts.text: Theo called it a cue until the lead asked for the log. I printed the hold, the photo, and the ticket. Packs left. Theo cued from the last row and told interns cues were always about optics. Optics is a word stickies use when a backpack exists. Seating now has a second line: INTERNS SIT LAST. I keep row C. Theo lasts. The dome finally looks like a sky, not a coat check. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.description: Hold log, open row, and a second line. Was a cue ever backpacks?
